observations.why: The act of switching to a new database technology appeals to novelty and self-direction — choosing a new path over the established one.
Performance gain appeals to achievement and mastery (10x capability), while cost reduction appeals to competitive standing; both frame the switch as a winning move.
The arrow notation frames the migration as directional change toward the new, appealing to novelty and self-direction.
Quantifying a tenfold capability gain directly appeals to mastery and quality of craft.
Setting a concrete timeline appeals to security and stability — pinning the change to a known quarter reduces uncertainty.
